Transport Modes

Багажная тележка

A low, wheeled trailer used at airports to transport passenger baggage between terminals and aircraft, referenced in IATA Ground Operations documentation.

Quick answer: A low, wheeled trailer used at airports to transport passenger baggage between terminals and aircraft, referenced in IATA Ground Operations documentation.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Багажная тележка?

In this glossary, Багажная тележка refers to: A low, wheeled trailer used at airports to transport passenger baggage between terminals and aircraft, referenced in IATA Ground Operations documentation.

How is Багажная тележка used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Багажная тележка была загружена зарегистрированным багажом и доставлена к самолёту, что отмечено в журнале наземных операций."

Why does Багажная тележка matter in logistics?

Багажная тележка matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Modes contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Багажная тележка?

Багажная тележка is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Багажная тележка belong to?

In this glossary, Багажная тележка is grouped under Transport Modes. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A low, wheeled trailer used at airports to transport passenger baggage between terminals and aircraft, referenced in IATA Ground Operations documentation.

Operational example

The baggage dolly was loaded with checked bags and towed to the aircraft, as noted in the ground operations log.
